name: Cloud Hosts
description: Puts your rented servers on the computers' page: lists the instances of your AWS (EC2 and Lightsail), Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud accounts and of common VPS panels (Pterodactyl / Pelican, SolusVM, Virtualizor, Proxmox VE, Hetzner Cloud, DigitalOcean, Vultr) and of servers without an API, shows whether each is running, starts, shuts down and restarts them, reads their addresses back, takes snapshots and opens their console. Bring a spot instance the vendor took back up again with one press. Credentials are kept in the hub's sealed secrets and never leave this extension.

custom_actions.title: Renew
custom_actions.confirm: Mark this server as renewed for another term? If you set a renewal webhook for it, that webhook is called.

aws_regions.title: AWS regions (EC2)
aws_regions.description: The regions to look for EC2 instances in, such as us-east-1. Every profile of the AWS credentials secret is read in each of them.

aws_lightsail_regions.title: AWS regions (Lightsail)
aws_lightsail_regions.description: The regions to look for Lightsail instances in. Leave empty when you do not use Lightsail.

gcp_projects.title: Google Cloud projects
gcp_projects.description: More project ids to read with the first service account key of the secret. Leave empty to read only each key's own project.

oci_compartments.title: Oracle Cloud compartments
oci_compartments.description: The OCIDs of the compartments to list instances in. Leave empty to list the tenancy's root compartment.

pterodactyl_url.title: Pterodactyl / Pelican panel address
pterodactyl_url.description: The address of the panel, such as https://panel.example.com.

solusvm_url.title: SolusVM panel address
solusvm_url.description: The address of a SolusVM 1 panel (its client API), such as https://vps.example.com:5656.

solusvm_tls_fingerprint.title: SolusVM certificate fingerprint
solusvm_tls_fingerprint.description: Only for a panel with a self-signed certificate: the SHA-256 fingerprint of that certificate. The connection is then accepted for this certificate only.

solusvm2_url.title: SolusVM 2 panel address
solusvm2_url.description: The address of a SolusVM 2 panel, such as https://vps.example.com.

virtualizor_url.title: Virtualizor panel address
virtualizor_url.description: The address of the Virtualizor end-user panel, with its port, such as https://vps.example.com:4083.

virtualizor_tls_fingerprint.title: Virtualizor certificate fingerprint
virtualizor_tls_fingerprint.description: Only for a panel with a self-signed certificate: the SHA-256 fingerprint of that certificate.

proxmox_url.title: Proxmox VE address
proxmox_url.description: The address of a Proxmox VE node or cluster, with its port, such as https://pve.example.com:8006.

proxmox_tls_fingerprint.title: Proxmox VE certificate fingerprint
proxmox_tls_fingerprint.description: Only for a node with a self-signed certificate: the SHA-256 fingerprint of that certificate (pvenode cert info shows it).

custom_webhook_url.title: Custom hosts: webhook address
custom_webhook_url.description: The address your own webhooks live at, such as https://hooks.example.com. A custom host's start, stop and renew paths are added to it.

custom_hosts.title: Custom hosts
custom_hosts.description: One server without an API per line, as key=value pairs separated by semicolons: name=free-vps; address=203.0.113.10; probe=tcp:22; start=/free-vps/start; stop=/free-vps/stop; console=https://panel.example.com/vps/1; expires=2027-01-31; term_days=30. See the extension's guide for every key.

secrets.name: aws_credentials
secrets.title: AWS credentials
secrets.description: The text of an AWS credentials file: a [default] profile (and more, each its own account) with aws_access_key_id and aws_secret_access_key. Use an IAM user limited to the EC2 and Lightsail actions this extension needs.

secrets.name: gcp_service_account
secrets.title: Google Cloud service account key
secrets.description: The JSON key file of a service account with the Compute Instance Admin role. Paste several keys one after another for several projects.

secrets.name: oci_config
secrets.title: Oracle Cloud API configuration
secrets.description: The text of an OCI configuration file: a [DEFAULT] profile with user, fingerprint, tenancy and region.

secrets.name: oci_private_key
secrets.title: Oracle Cloud API private key
secrets.description: The PEM private key of the API signing key named by the fingerprint above (unencrypted).

secrets.name: pterodactyl_api_key
secrets.title: Pterodactyl / Pelican API key
secrets.description: A client API key from the panel's Account > API Credentials. For several logins, one name=key per line.

secrets.name: solusvm_credentials
secrets.title: SolusVM API key and hash
secrets.description: From the panel's API page, as key:hash. SolusVM 1 has one pair per server: for several servers, one label=key:hash per line.

secrets.name: solusvm2_api_token
secrets.title: SolusVM 2 API token
secrets.description: An API token from the SolusVM 2 user area. For several accounts, one name=token per line.

secrets.name: virtualizor_credentials
secrets.title: Virtualizor API key and password
secrets.description: From the end-user panel's API Credentials, as key:password. For several accounts, one name=key:password per line.

secrets.name: proxmox_api_token
secrets.title: Proxmox VE API token
secrets.description: An API token as Proxmox shows it once: user@realm!tokenid=secret. Give it only the VM.Audit, VM.PowerMgmt and VM.Snapshot privileges, and VM.GuestAgent.Audit (VM.Monitor before Proxmox VE 9) so the addresses of virtual machines can be read. For several tokens, one name=user@realm!tokenid=secret per line.

secrets.name: hetzner_api_token
secrets.title: Hetzner Cloud API token
secrets.description: A read and write API token of a Hetzner Cloud project. For several projects, one name=token per line.

secrets.name: digitalocean_api_token
secrets.title: DigitalOcean API token
secrets.description: A personal access token with the droplet and snapshot scopes. For several accounts, one name=token per line.

secrets.name: vultr_api_key
secrets.title: Vultr API key
secrets.description: The API key from the Vultr account settings. For several accounts, one name=key per line.

secrets.name: custom_webhook_token
secrets.title: Custom hosts: webhook token
secrets.description: Optional. At least 8 characters, sent as a Bearer token with every webhook call of the custom hosts.
